notes.assumption_reps: One invocation = one cell = one arm, 48 turns, ONE rep of the grid (--reps 1): the shape the runner executes and the ledger charges 53 requests for. The rep label indexes the cell only. The pooled shape (pair --reps 3, context --reps 2) is probed separately because it is the only shape whose n satisfies G3's H1 floor; no cap, wall, horizon or n-floor was lowered anywhere.
notes.marginal_cost: The ledger charges 48 + ceil(48*68/801) = 53 requests per cell, so the ten cells cost 530 new requests; G1's displayed 1,154 per cell is the CUMULATIVE figure (1,101 already spent + 48 turns + 5 allowance), not a marginal price.
notes.warmup: run_longrun.py adds one 8-token warm-up per arm inside its own allocation; G1's would_spend = turns_total + allowance only, so the warm-up is NOT in cell.py's gate arithmetic -- it is declared here as not projected rather than silently omitted.

pooled_analysis_plan.call: analyze_stats.quantile_ci([r['ttft_ms'] for r in selected[arm]], q=0.95, resamples=10000, seed=20261020)
pooled_analysis_plan.grouping: by arm, pooling every rep of that arm; the pair comparison is pointer-stable (C) vs transcript-grow (A)
pooled_analysis_plan.owner: V-TRANCHE-1 (9d271c32): H1 per grid WITH its n, and no direction reported when the pooled intervals overlap
pooled_analysis_plan.p50_call: analyze_stats.quantile_ci(values, q=0.50) -- the materiality check, not a claim
pooled_analysis_plan.ranking_rule: disjoint 95% bootstrap intervals: C.hi < A.lo (PARM-1 H1 ranking_rule); overlapping intervals mean NO ranking claim
pooled_analysis_plan.rows_files: one per live cell (rows-tranch1-<arm>-<rep_label>-*.jsonl); NO SUCH FILE EXISTS YET -- this plan carries no measured number
pooled_analysis_plan.selector: analyze_stats.turn_latency_rows(rows) -> (selected, meta); one row per TURN, sample = row['ttft_ms'], absent/null/non-finite dropped and counted (never coerced to 0)
pooled_analysis_plan.stop_rule: p95 intervals overlap OR |p50(C) - p50(A)| < 100 ms => 'not adjudicable at this budget'
pooled_analysis_plan.when: after all ten cells settle and the rows exist; never at launch
